body:
I'm currently experiencing this on 4.7.2.stable on MacOS, except I'm using `popup.set_item_accelerator(0, KEY_MASK_SHIFT | KEY_A)`

The accelerator works, but the warning still shows. I tried using a region to ignore the warning using `@warning_ignore_start("int_as_enum_without_match")` and then `@warning_ignore_restore("int_as_enum_without_match")` but that actually causes the game to crash upon launch. The same happens if I try to use `@warning_ignore("int_as_enum_without_match")` on just a single line.

Note that disabling the match/cast warnings in the project settings does remove the warnings without issues.

Here's the crash report:
[crash_report.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33168274/crash_report.txt)
